thread.title_full: Kenley College Launches Leadership Excellence Accelerator Program (L.E.A.P) to Empower Emerging Government and Political Leaders

author: Inyo Register
title: Kenley College Launches Leadership Excellence Accelerator Program (L.E.A.P) to Empower Emerging Government and Political Leaders
text:
Greater Manchester, UK - March 5, 2025 - Kenley College, a leading UK-based online training provider, is pleased to announce the launch of the Leadership Excellence Accelerator Program (L.E.A.P), a six-week live online course designed to support emerging leaders in government and politics. It aims to equip participants with the skills and insights needed to navigate the challenges of the modern political landscape while driving meaningful impact.
L.E.A.P provides cohort-based sessions and expert-led learning experiences that address the unique and evolving demands of high-stakes roles. The curriculum focuses on building essential leadership capabilities such as strategic decision-making skills, the leadership mindset, management accountability, ethical leadership, and vision.
Leading the program is Dr. Lisa-Anne Chung, the President of Kenley College and a renowned Political Leadership Strategist. The author of the highly-rated book, Political Change, Dr. Chung brings timely insights into the shifting dynamics of political leadership. Because of her expertise in this area, she has become a leading voice in political leadership strategy.
“Government and political leadership today require more than policy knowledge – it demands vision, integrity, adaptability, and the ability to inspire and mobilise others in an era of rapid change,” said Dr. Chung, President of Kenley College. “L.E.A.P. is designed to help current and emerging leaders strengthen their leadership presence, sharpen decision-making, and build the confidence to lead effectively on national and global stages.”
Kenley College’s L.E.A.P. program incorporates national, local, and international perspectives to provide a well-rounded leadership development experience. With a global reach spanning the USA, UK, Europe, Canada, the Caribbean, Asia, and Africa, Kenley College delivers training programs aimed at enhancing leadership skills across diverse governance structures.
By fostering cross-cultural dialogue and exposing participants to different governance strategies, the program equips graduates with practical skills and a strategic mindset for effective leadership in government and politics.
The first L.E.A.P cohort begins this spring with applications now open.
For more information about Kenley College and to sign up for the L.E.A.P Program, please visit https://www.kenleycollege.com/ .
About Kenley College
Kenley College is an online training organisation empowering current and emerging leaders in government and politics with the essential leadership and management strategies needed to drive meaningful national transformation through: Accredited Certificate Programs, Customised Training and Workshops (Virtual/On-Site), and On-Demand Short Courses. Based in the UK, it cultivates global leadership excellence.
